title: ExtraStorage
description: Let your players have their own storage to store items when they mined or picked up it, and more...
body:
## Info

This plugin introduces virtual storage for players to store their mined/picked items. The players can filter what items to store, sort items in the storage, or sell items from the storage.

## Feature

- Support multiple versions: from 1.16 to the latest version
- Support Folia
- Support most popular skyblock plugins
- Support multiple currency plugins
- Support multiple marketplaces
- Support multiple custom item plugins
- PlaceholderAPI Supported
- HeadDatabase for custom head
- ItemsAdder and Oraxen for custom UI texture
- Very detailed explanation in every configuration files
- And a lot more that are not mentioned here

## FREE VERSION

This version is a free version, for the users who just want to try the plugin. The functionality is the same as the paid version. The only difference is:
- Free version doesn't receive official support for bug tracker or feature suggestion.
- Free version has a message to tell the user about the free version and where to buy the paid version.

If you like the plugin and want to support the development, or you want to receive official support, you can buy the paid version from [this page](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/extrastorage.90379/) or [this page](https://voxel.shop/product/860/extrastorage).
